claims: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be hosted by Canada, Mexico, and the United States from June 11 to July 19, 2026.
Italy will host the 2026 Winter Olympics and Paralympics.
The United States will celebrate its 250th anniversary (Semiquincentennial) in 2026.
Canada will celebrate its 250th anniversary in 2026.
A total solar eclipse will occur on August 12, 2026, visible in Greenland, Iceland, and Spain.
A total lunar eclipse is scheduled for March 2 or 3, 2026.
Patents for key weight-loss drugs (GLP-1) are expected to expire in major markets like Brazil, China, and India.
The 9th National Congress of the Workers' Party of Korea will feature the re-election of Kim Jong Un in 2026.
